<p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify; "><span style="font-size: 14px; line-height: 107%; font-family: Arial, sans-serif;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Landscaping&nbsp;
(Implementation)</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;"> - All hard and soft landscape works shall be carried
out in accordance with the approved details as shown 117.02 rev A. Prior to and during works, suitable and secure protective fencing will be used around trees of the front curtilage to protect against damage. Any
trees which die within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development,
are removed or become seriously damaged or diseased or are dying, shall&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 14px;">be replaced in the
next planting season with others of same approved specification, unless the
Local Planning Authority gives written consent to any variation. All hard
surfacing and means of enclosure shall be completed before the approved development is
first occupied.</span></p><p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:" arial",sans-serif;="" mso-fareast-font-family:aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:="" en-gb;mso-fareast-language:en-us;mso-bidi-language:ar-sa"=""></span></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align: justify;"><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;font-family:
" arial",sans-serif"=""><span style="font-size: 14px;"><u><span style="font-size: 14px;">Reason</span></u><span style="font-size: 14px;">:&nbsp; </span></span><span style="font-size: 14px;">To enhance
the appearance of the development in the interest of the amenities of the area,
to ensure the provision sustainable drainage surfaces and to comply with the
following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies G7 and D8 of the
London Plan 2021 and policies F15.7, F15.8, O15.1, O15.2 </span><span style="font-size: 14px;">&nbsp;</span><span style="font-size: 14px;">and O15.4 of the Local Plan 2024.</span><o:p></o:p></span></p>

Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.

Reason:  To comply with Section 91 (as amended) of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990.
description: APPLICATION FOR CREATION OF DROPPED KERB AND HARDSURFACING TO FRONT GARDEN AND ALTERATION TO FRONT BOUNDARY WALL TO FACILITATE PROVISON OF FRONT GARDEN PARKING.
